title: Upper density comparison and upper density theorem (Simon 3.3, 3.6, with 3.4, 3.5)
statement: For metric spaces X (in a common universe) and Borel regular outer measures μ on X, and real n ≥ 0: (3.3) if t ≥ 0 is real, A₁ ⊆ A₂ ⊆ X and Θ^{*n}(μ, A₂, x) ≥ t for all x ∈ A₁, then t·Hⁿ(A₁) ≤ μ(A₂); (3.6) if A ⊆ X is μ-measurable with μ(A) < ∞, then Θ^{*n}(μ, A, x) = 0 for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ X ∖ A.
